## Algorithm

* [The μF ≥ 2 GeV factorisation-scale veto](factorisation-scale-floor.md) - Per beam carrying a PDF with a dynamical μF, a point with q2fact < 4 GeV² is zero-weighted as in reweight.f; PointScales routes it; setup refuses only if every probe draw is vetoed.
* [MadGraph kT clustering: measures, admissible merges and the merge step](kt-clustering-algorithm.md) - MadGraph 3.7.1 cluster.f for dynamical_scale_choice = -1: run-card constants, djb/dj/BW measures, the merge graph from configs.inc, visit order and strict-< tie-break, the merge step and the core.
* [LHAPDF grids and the log-bicubic interpolation vibegraph replicates](lhapdf-interpolation.md) - LHAPDF6 .info/.dat layout, the local log-bicubic Hermite in (ln x, ln Q²), the subgrid walk and flavour aliasing, and the all-flavour f64 kernel (xfx_all) that evaluates it.
* [rewgt: α_s and PDF reweighting under ickkw = 1](mlm-rewgt.md) - MadEvent's rewgt factor per flavour combination: vertex classes, the PDF-ratio chain and its kills, goodjet, and vibegraph's coupling/cluster/rewgt.rs with per-member wiring.
* [setclscales under matching: two calls, two factorisation scales](mlm-scales.md) - MadEvent's first and second setclscales calls, q2bck, the central-scale overwrite and its jcentral guard, ptclus, and vibegraph's density versus record factorisation scale.
* [Out-of-grid PDFs and the ForcePositive clamp, as LHAPDF does them](pdf-extrapolation-and-force-positive.md) - LHAPDF's ContinuationExtrapolator per quadrant with log-or-linear values and low-Q² power law, its refusals, and the ForcePositive clamp read from .info, applied after both.
* [setclscales: from the cluster sequence to μR and per-beam μF](setclscales.md) - reweight.f's walk (ipart, jfirst/jlast/jcentral), mt2last/jcentral overrides, the μR geometric mean, per-beam μF branches, where scalefact lands on 3.7.1, and what SCALUP holds.

## Caveat

* [MadGraph's clustering scale depends on the integration channel](cluster-scale-channel-dependence.md) - The -1 scale reads the integration channel (nqcd filter, checkbw, igraphs collapse, jet memo, stale isbw); what that means for replay and σ, and the jet-memo rule with its proof.
* [The pinned PDF set is NNPDF23_lo_as_0130_qed, lhaid 247000](pinned-pdf-set.md) - The reference set is lhaid 247000; 244600 and 230000 are different NLO sets; cards with pdlabel = nn23lo1 use MadGraph's internal PDF, which the pdf layer cannot load, so rows bank at 247000.

## Design

* [The clustering configuration is drawn ∝ AMP2 per flavour group and beam ordering](clustering-configuration-draw.md) - Each flavour group and beam ordering draws its kT-clustering configuration ∝ its own AMP2_c (or MadEvent's channel-cut weight) from a substream uniform, so σ is partition-free.
* [vibegraph's kT clustering engine and how the scale is wired](kt-clustering-engine.md) - coupling/cluster/{graph,kt,setclscales,configs}.rs: channel forests from our diagrams, the inputs a scale consumes, cluster_scales and ClusterInput, one channel set per group.

## Design Decision

* [The LHAPDF interpolator is replicated in-house, not taken from scirs2](pdf-interpolation-in-house.md) - scirs2's global B-spline missed LHAPDF by up to 98.6% off-knot and pulled ~40 crates, so vibegraph replicates LHAPDF's local log-bicubic; the oracle is LHAPDF itself.
* [Per-event α_s by rescaling the folded constant pools](per-event-coupling-rescale.md) - ScaleAwareAmplitude moves pools to a per-event α_s by G-power tags, verified against full re-evaluation; couplings that are not monomials in G fall back to re-evaluating the model.

## Measurement

* [σ shifts from the AMP2 configuration draw and the per-group fix](configuration-draw-sigma-shifts.md) - Before/after σ of the clustered rows for the AMP2_c configuration draw (2026-08-03, branch val4-b) and for per-group, per-ordering scales (2026-09-26, 20 paired seeds against 14029ce).

## Overview

* [MLM matching: what vibegraph does and what the shower does](mlm-matching.md) - Scope of MLM in vibegraph (xqcut, ickkw = 1 scales, rewgt, the event record) versus the shower's veto, MadEvent's per-point call flow, and the cards that are refused.

## Physics Convention

* [Where α_s comes from: MadGraph's RGE or the PDF set's grid](alpha-s-sources.md) - MadGraph's own ALPHAS/NEWTON1 running with asmz from the PDF label, or at pdlabel = lhapdf LHAPDF's AlphaS_Ipol on the set's knots; AlphaSSource picks; α_EW never runs.
* [MadGraph's renormalisation and factorisation scale choices](madgraph-scale-choice.md) - Fixed scales, dynamical_scale_choice 1–5 closed forms and -1 clustering, per-beam μF, what -1 reduces to on 2 → 2 runs, and which choices vibegraph honours on which beams.
* [What SCALUP and AQCDUP hold, and the scale every record carries](record-scales.md) - SCALUP is the larger per-beam μF, not μR; AQCDUP is αs(μR), where MadGraph's carries a truncated π; no-aS models record 0; fixed-beam records carry the card default's clustered scale.
